Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.

Got it, love that you are aiming for value, not just cheap. Based on what most guys get the most wear out of, I would put these two at the top:

Leon three-pocket scrub top – Burgundy
Axim straight-leg scrub pant – Black

Quick comparison for value: • Fabric: Both are FIONx, so you get four way stretch, moisture wicking, anti wrinkle and odor control in the same set. That is where a lot of the “worth it” comes from on long shifts. • Pockets: Leon has 3 smart pockets (including a hidden one) so it stays clean looking but functional. Axim has 7 pockets and an athletic waistband, so you can carry a lot without needing a vest. • Fit: Leon is a modern V neck with a tailored but not tight fit, so it reads sharp in clinic and casual enough off shift. Axim is a straight leg with an athletic waistband, so it works for both standing and lots of bending or walking. • Longevity: Both are core, year round styles that hold up really well with repeated washing, so you are spreading the cost over a lot of wears.

If you want a single “bang for buck” set I would pair Leon on top with Axim on bottom. To fine tune, tell me your height, typical shift length and whether you prefer joggers or straight leg and I can confirm if Axim is the best call or if we should look at Tansen instead.
